entry.name: Pecharunt-S3
entry.flavor: It feeds others toxic mochi that draw out desires and capabilities. Those who eat the mochi fall under Pecharunt's control, chained to its will.

abilities.textEn: Pecharunt: If this Pokemon poisons a target, the target also becomes confused.
abilities.textEs: Pokémon poisoned by Pecharunt's moves will also become confused.
abilities.detail: If this Pokemon is a Pecharunt and poisons or badly poisons a target, the target also becomes confused.
abilities.detailEs: Cuando un Pokémon resulta envenenado por cualquiera de los movimientos de Pecharunt, también será confundido.
abilities.detailZh: 因桃歹郎的招式而陷入中毒状态的宝可梦，同时也会陷入混乱状态。
abilities.detailPt: Quando um Pokémon é envenenado por qualquer um dos movimentos de Pecharunt, ele também ficará confuso.
